the preferences of health consumers for self monitoring apps that promote sun protection are (1) to be able to generate data by taking photos, (2) to have control of their data, (3) to share their data with their general practitioner, (3) that reminder timing is not a preference, and (4) that cost is a preference, with the most preferred cost being free.
